description: After the checks exist: CODEOWNERS makes the owner review any change under test/stability/; a PR template line 'Touches a promised surface (kernel subset, runtime contract, public API, error codes)? Then a CHANGELOG entry.'; the release checklist (docs/agents or ci/README) gains a step: copy the new version's corpus, rejections, API snapshot and codes into test/stability/<version>/ from the tag. Also: the full platform matrix runs on release tags only (defk-1v7); state in the release step that the stability checks must pass on the matrix before publishing. Done when the three are committed.
